From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@acme.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Quick sanity check on rating distribution?

Jonas —

Thanks again for the data export. We ran the distribution analysis on the packet you shared and flagged a few small clusters that look like rating inflation in one team and a spike of low ratings in another. Before we proceed with the official letters, can you or your calibration leads confirm whether the spike in the Platform group (two people marked as 5s within one ladder step) is an intentional compression? Also we saw an outlier in Solutions (one 1 rating that may be a mis-entry).

If you prefer, I can join a 20–30 minute call to walk through the sheet. We need confirmed numbers by EOD Friday to meet Acme's review timeline.

Best,
Elaine Turner
Sr. HR Partner — Acme Corp
People Ops (external)

Attachment: acme_review_notes.pdf (1 page summary)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@acme.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Quick sanity check on rating distribution? — please review and indicate exceptions

Team — forwarding Elaine's note and the flagged export. Short ask: can each of you review your direct-report buckets in the attached rollup and reply with either (A) confirm as-is, (B) one-line reason for an exception + proposed new rating, or (C) ask for a 15-min sync. We need consolidated confirmation for Acme by Friday EOD.

Notes and constraints: keep any 5s documented with promotion-readiness notes (we'll capture in calibration minutes) and double-check that any 1s have corroborating performance improvement documentation. If you submit an exception, please attach the snippet of feedback or a link to the evaluation comment.

I attached a filtered tab ("redwood_rollup_v5") and a quick change log. I expect short replies — no long narratives.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-12-calibration-rollup.xlsx (excel, 5 tabs), individual_raters_notes_jonas.pdf (pdf, 3 pages)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T08:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Quick sanity check on rating distribution? — proposed adjustments

Jonas / all —

I dug into Platform's five-rated folks. Two items:
- Person A (platform infra) was put at a 5 because we have an approved promo and a roadmap leadership note from Sept; I can attach the promo approval email if needed. Recommend keeping the 5 but adding the promotion flag into the rollup.
- Person B (platform infra) looks inflated — rater mistakenly copied the wrong ladder level. I propose we move B from 5 -> 4 and note the correction in the comments column.

I attached a brief one-pager with the two audit points. Also noticed the Solutions 1 — that's actually a data-entry error. The rater meant to flag "needs improvement" as level 2 in our internal scale; propose switching that to 2 and leaving a note.

If nobody objects by EOD Thursday, I'll update the spreadsheet and push the corrected version to the shared drive.

-Markus
SVP, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: markus_adjustments_2026-12.pdf (2 pages)
